Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group. He first said 300 in the #strategic-pod thread on July 1. About five minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins left over from their May rollout. The 280 is the number of active seats on the production roster as of July 1.

Use 280 in the QBR deck.
